overall_summary: Patch 26.14 focuses on bug fixes and rune-interaction tuning for Azir, nerfs to overperforming Jayce, Garen, Locke, Senna, and Seraphine, buffs to underperforming Mordekaiser, Nami, Corki, and Yunara, tuning to Immortal Path, Protoplasm Harness, and Hextech Rocketbelt, a Blue Buff ability haste scaling buff, a broad ARAM Mayhem augment rebalance (nerfing Dropkick, buffing several weak augments), a wide Arena champion/item/augment balance pass focused on buffing underperformers (especially Locke and Zoe), buff-bar UI cleanup plus QoL changes like automatic remake votes, and a T1 Worlds three-peat cosmetic release wave including five T1 Signature Bundles, MVP T1 Miss Fortune, Victorious Rengar, a Megabundle, a Mythic Shop Nexus Finisher, and five chromas.

changes.summary: Scorch, Liandry's Torment, Blackfire Torch, and Hextech Alternator now deal 100% of their damage on-hit against Azir's soldiers instead of 50%.
Conqueror now applies 2 stacks per on-hit instead of 1 via Arise!.
Press the Attack now applies to the primary target hit by Arise!.
Emperor's Divide (R) now knocks back jungle monsters.
Attack Damage growth per level increased from 2 to 2.5.
Missile Barrage (R) remaining recharge time reduction from autos increased from 2-4 seconds to 2-6 seconds based on critical strike chance.
Demacian Justice (R) true damage reduced from 150/250/350 to 125/200/275.
Hextech Capacitor passive bonus move speed reduced from 40 to 30.
Mercury Hammer (R) bonus Armor and Magic Resistance reduced from 5/15/25/35 to 5/12/19/26.
Ritual Nails (Q) recast hold time reduced from 5 to 4 seconds.
Ritual Nails (Q) nail damage reduced from 50/60/70/80/90 to 50/58/66/74/82.
Ritual Nails (Q) mark base bonus damage reduced from 20/30/40/50/60 to 18/26/34/42/50.
Soul Ignition (W) damage taken grey health cap reduced from 40/80/120/160/200 to 40/70/100/130/160.
Death's Grasp (E) damage increased from 60/75/90/105/120 to 60/80/100/120/140 and its Ability Power ratio increased from 40% to 45%.
Realm of Death (R) stat steal increased from 10% to 13%.
Tidecaller's Blessing (E) damage per hit increased from 20/30/40/50/60 to 20/35/50/65/80.
Absolution passive critical strike damage modifier reduced from 85% to 80%.
Piercing Darkness (Q) Ability Power slow ratio reduced from 10% per 100 AP to 7% per 100 AP.
Piercing Darkness (Q) Ability Power healing ratio reduced from 50% to 35%.
High Note (Q) Ability Power ratio reduced from 50% to 40%.
Attack Damage growth per level increased from 2.5 to 3.
Bonus damage increase while above 50% max health reduced from 5% to 4%.
Healing, shielding, and regeneration increase while below 50% max health reduced from 15% to 12%.
Cost increased from 2500 to 2600 gold.
Bonus health range reduced from 200-300 to 100-300.
Healing range reduced from 200-400 to 100-400.
Build path changed from Hextech Alternator + Fiendish Codex + Amplifying Tome + 300 gold to Hextech Alternator + Kindlegem + Ruby Crystal + 350 gold.
Active ability cooldown increased from 40 to 50 seconds.
Ability Power reduced from 70 to 60.
Health increased from 300 to 350.
Ability Haste granted changed from a flat 10 to 10/15/20 scaling at levels 1/6/11.
ARAM Mayhem augment cooldown reduced from 108s to 75s (faster but with lower per-use stats relative to before, per accompanying stat cuts).
ARAM Mayhem augment Attack Damage range increased from 25-100 to 35-150.
ARAM Mayhem augment Ability Power range increased from 25-100 to 35-150.
ARAM Mayhem augment Health range increased from 200-1000 to 300-1500.
ARAM Mayhem augment now deals 1 damage to structures.
ARAM Mayhem augment time between poro spawns reduced from 35-20 to 25-15.
ARAM Mayhem augment base damage increased from 50-100 to 100-200.
ARAM Mayhem augment shield per slappee increased from 25-75 to 35-150.
ARAM Mayhem augment now executes a target if accumulated damage would kill it.
ARAM Mayhem augment base value reduced from 5% to 4%.
ARAM Mayhem augment base attack damage scaling increased from 0.035% to 0.055%.
ARAM Mayhem augment bonus health scaling reduced from 0.002% to 0.0001%.
ARAM Mayhem augment penetration per tooth reduced from 4 to 3.
ARAM Mayhem augment no longer reduces cooldowns when affecting non-champions.
ARAM Mayhem augment will no longer affect other augment or item effects.
Fixed a bug where the ARAM Mayhem augment could grant infinite Attack Range.
Fixed a bug where the ARAM Mayhem augment did not grant gold from champions' damage-over-time effects like Darius, Teemo, and Twitch.
Fixed a bug where Smolder could be offered the Combusting Interest augment in ARAM Mayhem.
Fixed a bug where the ARAM Mayhem augment did not correctly grant bonus move speed with Master Yi's E, Ashe's Q, and Twitch's Q.
Fixed a bug where the ARAM Mayhem augment sometimes failed to drop an Anvil when a unit died.
Fixed a bug where the ARAM Mayhem augment's Drop Bear could sometimes die immediately after spawning.
Fixed a bug in ARAM Mayhem where players could still get another active summoner spell after choosing Shark Tempest and SnowBomb.
Fixed a bug where the ARAM Mayhem augment Pursuit of Haste was offered to Yasuo E.
Arena: Q1 base attack damage ratio reduced from 60% to 45%.
Arena: Q2 base attack damage ratio reduced from 90% to 70%.
Arena: passive heal ratio increased from 3.5% to 5.5%.
Arena: E base damage increased from 80-220 to 80-260.
Arena: Q beam base damage increased from 30-90 to 40-120.
Arena: Q beam Ability Power ratio increased from 45% to 55%.
Arena: Q passive tentacle damage amplification increased from 4%-20% to 10%-30%.
Arena: passive mount cooldown reduced from 15 to 12.
Arena: fixed a bug so Power Flowers now correctly grants courage.
Arena: Q cooldown reduced from 10-6 to 8.5-4.5.
Arena: E cooldown reduced from 10 to 8.
Arena: E2 Ability Power ratio increased from 0.4 to 0.65.
Arena: R cooldown reduced from 120-80 to 90-60.
Arena: passive Harrier cooldown reduced from 7s-2.56s to 5s-1.83s.
Arena: E cooldown reduced from 12-8 to 10-6.
Arena: Q base damage increased from 70-250 to 95-275.
Arena: R damage increased from 10/20/30 to 15/30/45.
Arena: E move distance post-grab increased from 675 to 1000.
Arena: R base damage increased from 250-450 to 350-550.
Arena: move speed while R is active increased from 40% to 60%.
Arena: R demonic power generated per second while draining increased from 20 to 25.
Arena: demonic power lost increased from 10 to 15.
Arena: amped demonic power lost after 5s increased from 15 to 20.
Arena: Q missing health ratio increased from 3%-7% to 6%-10%.
Arena: R Maiden health modifier increased from 70% to 100%.
Arena: passive Ability Power ratio increased from 35% to 40%.
Arena: Q Ability Power ratio increased from 0.6-1.5 to 0.7-1.75.
Arena: W magic damage per bolt increased from 15-55 to 20-80.
Arena: R cooldown reduced from 11-5 to 8-2.
Arena: Wildfire now counts as a burn effect for item interactions.
Arena: move speed changed from 8%-10% (scaling) to a flat 10%.
Arena: attack speed increased from 60% to 65%.
Arena: attack speed increased from 35% to 40%.
Arena: attack speed increased from 35% to 40%.
Arena: attack speed increased from 30% to 35%.
Arena augment cooldown now reduced by 2 seconds when you trigger Hexbolt.
Arena augment's max level capstone now triggers even if already invulnerable from Divine Intervention.
Arena augment now properly works with Quantum Computing, multicasting with a 0.25s delay for a max invulnerability duration of 3.5 seconds.
Fixed an issue in Arena where having both augments would sometimes prevent a spell from critting.
Arena: Double Tap interaction now has a 5 second per-spell cooldown.
Arena: Critical Rhythm interaction now has a 4 second per-spell cooldown.
Arena augment Twin Fire has been disabled.
Arena augment execute threshold at level 1 reduced from 0.75 (16.25%) to 0.5 (12.5%).
Arena augment execute threshold at level 2 reduced from 1.25 (23.75%) to 1 (20%).

Cleaned up the buff bar by trimming redundant buffs, moving most timed item buffs into item inventory slots, reducing clutter from low-impact system/map/item effects, and removing display of very short-duration debuffs (~0.25s).
Fixed a bug where Caitlyn's Headshot may fail to fire while in brush.
Remake votes now begin automatically when eligible instead of requiring a player to type /remake, with chat context explaining who triggered it and why.
Deafen and self-mute can now only be toggled once every 60 seconds to prevent spam and disruptive one-way communication.
